description: Guard hooks shared with Claude Code. Binaries are built from home/.agents/hooks and stowed to ~/.agents/hooks; -harness=codex selects the Codex permission mapping (an explicit allow is suppressed so Codex's own approval flow stays in charge, and an ask becomes a deny because Codex cannot prompt from a PreToolUse hook). enforce-root is deliberately absent: it forbids a top-level cd because Claude Code does not persist the working directory between Bash calls, which is not Codex's exec model.
